name: Prevent cross-contamination
short_description: Separate raw and ready-to-eat foods and clean contact surfaces during one preparation session.
self_assessment: I can prevent cross-contamination throughout one food preparation session without help.
description: Separate raw and ready-to-eat foods and clean contact surfaces during one preparation session. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Use separate clean surfaces for raw and ready-to-eat food
safety_note: Contamination can cause illness; wash hands, separate raw items, clean surfaces, and keep food at safe storage temperatures.
